dedupe_keys.name: impact of hybrid facts devices on kenya s power transmission system data

description: Impact of hybrid FACTS devices on Kenya's power transmission system data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Ariel Mbae. This data was obtained on the use of paired (hybrid) Flexible Alternating Current Transmission System (FACTS) devices and studying their impact on voltage, small signal and transient stability simultaneously under various system disturbances on Kenya's transmission network. Coverage: national (KE); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
